summary: The TypeScript SDK should log diagnostic information when Workflow Task completion takes longer than expected, providing visibility into performance bottlenecks. This is part of a cross-SDK feature implementation effort.
userImpact: Users lack visibility into slow workflow task completions, making it harder to diagnose performance issues in production.
proposedFix: Add logging when WFT completion takes a long time; coordinate implementation across core-based SDKs for consistency
keyQuote: Should investigate if we can push this information into sdk-rust repo so that all core-based SDKs report in a similar manner.
